description: Defines models and methods for managing contact information within the OpenERP (Odoo) framework, including classes for contacts, addresses, and jobs.

classes.name: res_partner_contact
classes.description: Model for contact persons associated with partners, including methods for retrieving titles and main jobs.

classes.name: res_partner_address
classes.description: Model for partner addresses, overriding name_get to customize display.

classes.name: res_partner_job
classes.description: Model for partner job roles and functions, with methods for display names.

methods.name: _title_get
methods.description: Retrieves contact titles with domain 'contact' for selection.

methods.name: _main_job
methods.description: Determines the main job for a contact.

methods.name: name_get
methods.description: Generates display names for contacts, addresses, and jobs.

methods.name: name_search
methods.description: Searches contacts by name or first name.

methods.name: onchange_address
methods.description: Updates partner ID based on selected address.
